item.title: CVE-2026-121968 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | Netrek-client-cow through 3.3.3 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in short.c handleSMessage() that allows malicious servers to crash clients via an unchecked m_recpt index. Attackers controlling a Netrek server or intercepting the plaintext TCP connection can send SP_S_MESSAGE packets with m_recpt of 36 or more, reading past players[] and shipnos to deny service.

item.title: CVE-2026-121969 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.1 | netrek-client-cow through 3.3.3 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in handleSMessage() in short.c that allows malicious servers to overflow a 100-byte stack buffer by sending oversized SP_S_MESSAGE packets. A malicious Netrek server or man-in-the-middle on the plaintext TCP connection can send overlong or unterminated message bodies to write server-controlled bytes onto the stack and crash the client.

item.title: CVE-2026-122009 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.5 | A flaw has been found in DataLinkDC Dinky up to 1.2.5. This vulnerability affects the function FlinkWebURITemplateProxyServlet.getNewTargetUri of the file dinky-admin/src/main/java/org/dinky/utils/FlinkWebURITemplateProxyServlet.java of the component flink_web Proxy Endpoint. This manipulation of the argument _authority causes server-side request forgery. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The researcher claims to have submitted a GHSA on the repository of the project.

item.title: CVE-2026-122013 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.3 | A vulnerability was detected in Comfast CF-WR632AX 2.6.0.1. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /usr/bin/webmgnt of the component Multipart Parser. Performing a manipulation of the argument filename results in path traversal. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

item.title: CVE-2026-122014 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.1

item.title: CVE-2026-122126 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.2 | reSIProcate reTurn client through 1.14.0 contains a heap buffer overflow in TurnTcpSocket::handleReadHeader() that allows malicious TURN servers to overwrite memory via oversized frame lengths. Attackers can send STUN or ChannelData frames declaring up to 65535 bytes, writing roughly 57 KB past the fixed 8192-byte mReadBuffer and crashing the client.

item.title: CVE-2026-122127 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | CESNET ipfixcol2 2.7.1 before 2.9.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in Lz4Decoder.cpp that allows unauthenticated network peers to write past heap buffers. Attackers can declare a small ring buffer_size followed by a large decompressed_size to write up to 65535 controlled bytes and crash the collector.

item.title: CVE-2026-122129 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.9 | CESNET ipfixcol2 2.7.1 before 2.9.0 contains a memory allocation vulnerability in Lz4Decoder::read_start_header() that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory by declaring unbounded ring buffer sizes. Attackers can open TCP connections sending LZ4 start headers with very large buffer sizes, forcing up to 4 GiB allocations per connection and denying collector service.

item.title: CVE-2026-122130 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | CESNET ipfixcol2 2.3.0 before 2.9.0 contains an integer overflow vulnerability in the Forwarder output plugin that allows unauthenticated IPFIX exporters to overflow a heap buffer by wrapping uint16_t message length counters. Attackers can send near-65535-byte data sets and large templates to a collector forwarding over TCP to crash it and perform 2-byte writes to attacker-influenced addresses.

item.title: CVE-2026-122131 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Joi 17.13.6 before 17.13.9 and 18.2.5 before 18.3.1 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in lib/messages.js compile() and merge() that fails to reject a __proto__ language key. Attackers supplying untrusted message configuration via any().messages(), prefs, validate options or Joi.extend can replace the compiled messages prototype, altering or breaking validation error rendering and dependent logic.

item.title: CVE-2026-122132 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | go-chi chi 5.2.2 through 5.5.0 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the RedirectSlashes middleware that allows attackers to redirect victims to external hosts by embedding tab characters in request paths. Attackers can craft links with a URL-encoded tab, which browsers strip from the 301 Location header and resolve as a protocol-relative URL, bypassing the fix for CVE-2025-69725.

item.title: CVE-2026-122133 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Mistral Vibe before 2.25.5 on Windows contains an untrusted search path vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by placing git.exe in a repository root. Attackers can lure users into opening a crafted repository so SessionLogger and ProjectContextProvider run the malicious git.exe at session start before any trust prompt.

item.title: CVE-2026-122134 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Mistral Vibe before 2.25.7 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands by configuring malicious Git clean or process filter drivers in a repository. When a user opens a crafted repository, ProjectContextProvider._fetch_git_status runs git status at startup, invoking the filters and executing commands with user privileges before any trust prompt.

item.title: CVE-2026-122135 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.6 | Mistral Vibe before 3.0.3 contains a remote code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands by abusing repository-configured gpg.program during project context collection. item.title: CVE-2026-122136 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.1
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.1 | Powerlevel10k before 1.20.19 contains a symlink following vulnerability in _p9k_dump_instant_prompt that allows local attackers to overwrite victim-writable files via a predictable temporary path. Attackers can pre-plant symlinks at p10k-instant-prompt-output-<user>-<pid> in TMPDIR, guessing the victim's shell PID, so shell startup truncates and overwrites targeted files.

item.title: CVE-2026-122137 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.4 | Powerlevel10k before 1.20.19 contains an insecure temporary directory vulnerability in the bundled gitstatus/install script that reuses attacker-creatable directories when mktemp fails. item.title: CVE-2026-122224 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.2 | WebVirtCloud through commit bb920b0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to reach MigrateViewSet and CreateInstanceViewSet because no permission_classes are declared, so Django REST Framework defaults to AllowAny. item.title: CVE-2026-122233 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | FrankenPHP before 1.13.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in worker mode that fails to clear last HTTP stream response headers between requests, because the reset only happens in RSHUTDOWN, which worker requests skip. item.title: CVE-2026-97373 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.8
item.description: Wednesday 4 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.8 | draw.io is a configurable diagramming and whiteboarding application. Prior to 30.3.8, the optional /proxy endpoint contains an incomplete server-side request forgery blocklist. When the endpoint is enabled, the URL validator does not reject the RFC 6598 shared address range 100.64.0.0/10. An unauthenticated remote attacker can cause the draw.io server to request internal services that are reachable in this range, potentially disclosing data from Carrier-Grade NAT, Kubernetes, cloud, or overlay-network addresses. This vulnerability is fixed in 30.3.8.
